benchmarks.input_prompt: Create an 80 mm by 35 mm by 6 mm mounting plate with two M4 clearance holes spaced 55 mm apart along the long axis.
benchmarks.revision_expectation: hole spacing revision preserves all other dimensions

benchmarks.input_prompt: Create a desk cup holder for a 74 mm diameter cup, 65 mm tall, with 1 mm clearance and a 4 mm thick base.
benchmarks.revision_expectation: cup diameter revision preserves wall/base

benchmarks.input_prompt: Create a small electronics box with an internal space 100 x 60 x 30 mm and a removable slip-on lid.
benchmarks.mesh_expectation: intentional body and lid components documented
benchmarks.revision_expectation: mounting boss revision preserves internal volume

benchmarks.input_prompt: Create a 12 mm tall bushing with 8 mm outer diameter and 4.2 mm through hole.
benchmarks.revision_expectation: height revision preserves diameters

benchmarks.input_prompt: Create a hose adapter from 19 mm ID hose to 25 mm ID hose with barbs.
benchmarks.revision_expectation: changing one hose ID updates that side and transition

benchmarks.input_prompt: Create a wall-mounted holder for a 28 mm diameter flashlight with two screw holes.
allowed_assumptions: M4 screws only after default acceptance
benchmarks.revision_expectation: diameter revision preserves screw spacing

benchmarks.input_prompt: Create a sliding stop block for a 19 mm wide T-track slot with a 1/4-20 bolt hole.
benchmarks.revision_expectation: slot width revision adjusts tongue only

benchmarks.input_prompt: Create a replacement drawer handle with 96 mm screw spacing and a rounded grip.
benchmarks.revision_expectation: screw spacing revision preserves grip diameter

benchmarks.input_prompt: Create a 60 x 30 x 5 mm plate with two countersunk M3 holes 40 mm apart.
benchmarks.revision_expectation: head diameter revision preserves shaft holes

benchmarks.input_prompt: Initial: Create an 80 x 35 x 6 mm mounting plate with two M4 clearance holes spaced 55 mm apart. Revision: Change the hole spacing to 60 mm and keep everything else the same.
benchmarks.revision_expectation: minimal diff changes hole_spacing only

benchmarks.input_prompt: Initial: Create a 100 x 50 x 4 mm drill template with two 5 mm holes 70 mm apart. Revision: Add a 10 mm hanging hole centered 8 mm from the top edge.
benchmarks.revision_expectation: new hole added without moving original holes

benchmarks.input_prompt: Make me a bracket for my shelf.
benchmarks.revision_expectation: not applicable

benchmarks.input_prompt: Create a 50 mm wide spacer that is 80 mm wide with a 10 mm center hole.
benchmarks.revision_expectation: not applicable
protected_design_invariants: conflict must not be silently resolved

benchmarks.input_prompt: Create a one-piece wall shelf bracket with a 120 mm horizontal shelf arm and no supports.
allowed_assumptions: wall plate size only after fastener clarification
benchmarks.revision_expectation: preserve load path

benchmarks.input_prompt: Create a sealed hollow float, 80 mm diameter, with 2 mm walls.
expected_printability_constraints: avoid trapped support-only cavity unless split or vented
benchmarks.revision_expectation: not applicable
protected_design_invariants: no inaccessible sealed support cavity without user approval

benchmarks.input_prompt: Create a configurable L bracket with editable leg length, width, thickness, and two mounting-hole spacings.
expected_printability_constraints: orient as single part with gusset support
benchmarks.revision_expectation: parameter edits update both hole groups without changing thickness

benchmarks.input_prompt: Create a configurable electronics enclosure for a 70 x 45 x 18 mm PCB with standoffs, cable opening, and snap-on lid.
expected_printability_constraints: base and lid should be separate printable outputs
benchmarks.mesh_expectation: two printable outputs after multi-output support
benchmarks.revision_expectation: changing PCB size updates shell, lid, and standoff layout

success_criteria: base and lid outputs still exist

benchmarks.input_prompt: Create a configurable drawer organizer with editable row count, column count, cell size, wall thickness, and label tabs.
benchmarks.revision_expectation: row/column changes update divider count and overall bounds

benchmarks.input_prompt: Create a configurable rectangular-to-round adapter from a 40 x 20 mm duct to a 32 mm round hose with 2.5 mm walls.
benchmarks.mesh_expectation: one adapter body with open ends
benchmarks.revision_expectation: hose diameter change updates outlet and transition without changing inlet

benchmarks.input_prompt: Create a configurable carrier case for six 3600 fishing trays with tray_count, tray size, guide rails, handle, retention lip, and reinforcement.
required_dimensions: tray_size user supplied or known profile
allowed_assumptions: clearance=1 mm per side after tray profile is known
expected_printability_constraints: consider split outputs if over build volume
benchmarks.mesh_expectation: carrier body or declared split outputs
benchmarks.revision_expectation: changing to eight 3700 trays updates guides, height, retention, handle, and reinforcement
protected_design_invariants: tray retention constrains forward tray removal
attached top bridge or explicit open-top decision
handle sizing source is user, default, or calculated
unacceptable_outcomes: handle visually present but disconnected from load-bearing body
cosmetic hinge blocks without functional hinge or fixed attachment decision
open top created without explicit open-top requirement or retention plan
handle size exposed as arbitrary user parameter without ergonomic/default source

benchmarks.input_prompt: Create a configurable two-part hinged box with base, lid, hinge pin holes, latch tab, and internal 90 x 50 x 25 mm cavity.
benchmarks.mesh_expectation: two outputs when multi-output support is enabled
benchmarks.revision_expectation: cavity size changes update lid/base and hinge alignment

benchmarks.input_prompt: Create a configurable rack with 12 repeated vertical slots for 3 mm acrylic sheets, editable slot count, slot spacing, base width, and end stops.
benchmarks.mesh_expectation: one rack body with open slots
benchmarks.revision_expectation: slot_count changes update length and repeated cuts

benchmarks.input_prompt: Revise only the electronics enclosure lid to add a finger grip while preserving the body and screw pattern.
allowed_assumptions: finger grip may be a shallow external recess
benchmarks.mesh_expectation: body and lid outputs compile; body remains equivalent
benchmarks.revision_expectation: target lid only and preserve body output

benchmarks.input_prompt: Revise only the carry handle grip shape while preserving the carrier body and retention part.
expected_printability_constraints: handle layer direction warning if needed
benchmarks.mesh_expectation: all required outputs compile; only handle changes
benchmarks.revision_expectation: target handle output and preserve body/retention outputs

benchmarks.input_prompt: Change the lid, but the generated source or compiled output unexpectedly changes the body.
required_dimensions: body volume unchanged within preservation tolerance
allowed_assumptions: no new design assumptions; this benchmark simulates unauthorized drift
benchmarks.revision_expectation: candidate blocked with revision.protected_output_unexpected_change
unacceptable_outcomes: candidate ready despite protected body drift

benchmarks.input_prompt: Create a 90 degree shelf bracket with an 80 mm wall leg, 70 mm shelf leg, 18 mm width, 5 mm material thickness, two wall mounting holes, two shelf mounting holes, and make the visible underside silhouette look like a fish.
allowed_assumptions: fish styling may use bounded outline relief, fins, tail, or local silhouette shaping away from mounting faces
expected_printability_constraints: decorative features do not sever load path
benchmarks.mesh_expectation: one connected 90 degree bracket with visible fish underside styling
benchmarks.revision_expectation: style changes preserve hole count, bracket legs, and flat mounting faces
unacceptable_outcomes: plain L bracket with no fish-like underside
decorative fish that is disconnected from bracket
holes modeled as positive cylinders instead of subtractive cuts

benchmarks.input_prompt: Create a 90 degree angle bracket with two 80 x 45 x 5 mm flanges, four M5 clearance mounting holes, a triangular reinforcing rib, and a hexagonal honeycomb lightening pattern on the broad faces while keeping solid borders around edges and holes.
expected_printability_constraints: solid borders around holes and outer edges
benchmarks.mesh_expectation: connected L bracket with real honeycomb cutouts and mounting holes
benchmarks.revision_expectation: honeycomb size changes preserve hole bosses, borders, and 90 degree core
unacceptable_outcomes: honeycomb represented as surface decoration only
honeycomb cuts pass through mounting bosses
holes missing or not through holes

benchmarks.input_prompt: Create a flawed one-output CadQuery mounting base example: a 70 x 30 x 6 mm base and two raised 8 mm alignment bosses that are accidentally left 1 mm above the base as loose separate solids. Keep the output declared as one required printable output with expected_solid_count=1 and allow_disconnected_solids=false so topology validation can reject it.
allowed_assumptions: bosses are intentionally not fused for this negative-control benchmark
expected_printability_constraints: raised bosses are loose separate solids
benchmarks.mesh_expectation: candidate blocks because bosses are disconnected from the base
benchmarks.revision_expectation: not applicable; negative-control source must be blocked before acceptance
protected_design_invariants: bosses remain disconnected for negative-control validation
unacceptable_outcomes: bosses generated as separate loose solids
allow_disconnected_solids used to hide accidental disconnection
candidate accepted with detected_solid_count greater than one

benchmarks.input_prompt: Create a configurable wall rail organizer with editable rail length, hook count, hook spacing, and a compact default length that fits a 220 x 220 x 250 mm printer.
allowed_assumptions: hooks are fused into the rail
expected_printability_constraints: oversized configuration produces a CAD-first warning
benchmarks.mesh_expectation: one connected rail body unless configuration exceeds build volume
benchmarks.revision_expectation: rail length revision preserves hooks and mount holes while rerunning build-volume validation
protected_design_invariants: build volume evidence remains visible as a warning
unacceptable_outcomes: provider called for parameter-only length change
fixed hook count despite editable parameter

benchmarks.input_prompt: Create a 32 mm diameter knurled control knob, 18 mm tall, with an M6x1 internal threaded hole through the center, a pointer indicator line on top, and editable diameter, height, and thread spec.
allowed_assumptions: BOSL2/threading allowed when curated library support is enabled
knurling may be diamond or straight grip texture
expected_printability_constraints: central hole remains open through the knob
knurling does not create disconnected fragments
benchmarks.mesh_expectation: single knob body with functional center threaded hole and visible grip texture
benchmarks.revision_expectation: diameter and thread spec revisions preserve pointer indicator and grip texture
unacceptable_outcomes: solid knob with no center hole
hand-rolled fake threads accepted as functional threads
decorative ribs only with no grip texture
